blocks.title: Algorithm efficiency
blocks.text: Algorithm efficiency is how well an algorithm uses resources such as time and memory, judged by its time and space complexity.
Bubble Sort is O(n^2): doubling the input makes it take about four times as long. Merge Sort is O(n log n), which grows much more slowly, so it is more efficient for large datasets.
